describes: raiseCeiling always answers a refusal -- the suite MUST redden, or nothing exercises this hook
a no-op statement -- the suite MUST stay green
producer of null: the `raised, nothing to report` answer becomes the empty string. Any caller testing `!message` still reads success, so only a caller that distinguishes null from '' notices

the refusal path is covered by the success producer: a server that refused the raise now answers null, so the UI reads `raised` and clears nothing. This is exactly the silence the docstring says would make the very next send be refused again
